prompts.idle: Production sprites for American Girl Doll Race. Reference is the approved UPDATED RUMI vinyl play doll. Preserve her EXACT rounded doll face, brown inset eyes, warm light-medium skin, glossy VIOLET-PURPLE hair swept up into a braided crown with ONE thick long braid over her shoulder, yellow satin embroidered bomber jacket with black collar/cuffs and colorful geometric sleeve/lapel embroidery, white top, navy short skirt with gold stitching/zip, black-and-gold belt and draped gold chain/charm, white sock cuffs, chunky black boots with purple laces. Sturdy 18-inch vinyl play doll, miniature sewn fabrics, molded joints, detailed rooted hair. Personality: quietly confident, warm leader, focused and poised but playful. Same anatomical face/head/torso/limb size in all cells. Exactly THREE equal SQUARE cells in one WIDE 3:1 horizontal strip; one full doll in each cell, generous transparent margins, clear gaps, no overlap/cropping. Standing hair-to-shoes about 600px within each 724px square, not full canvas height. Face RIGHT in a slight three-quarter view. Long braid curls compactly behind/along her body, not spread far sideways; no hair or boot outside cell. True transparent background, no floor, shadows, glow, text, labels or grid. No props or weapons. Three grounded idles: 1 relaxed confident neutral stand, both hands down; 2 subtle weight shift, warm small smile, arms relaxed; 3 one hand on hip, composed chin lift and knowing smile. Same standing height and foot baseline.
